title: 观察者模式：订单变了，谁该收到通知？
style: Observer-pattern-first lesson: order17 product operation, motivation for changing receivers, standard source/observer contract/concrete observer roles, explicit before-payment registration replay, source-first notification and receiver-owned reactions, close/unsubscribe then same-order shipment to remaining recipient, benefits and lifecycle costs. Only shot09 briefly maps the idea to existing event mechanisms and cross-service MQ pub/sub; return to observer core for conclusion. Preserve paid/shipped history and stopped summary semantics, clean dark canvas, no decorative progress, separate five-second silent Java excerpt.
userScope: Latest user feedback rejects the MQ-heavy v0.68.4 direction. Main lesson must teach Observer motivation, roles and subscribe/notify/unsubscribe collaboration; MQ is one brief practical application only. Preserve original order17/summary/change-record example, concise Java pause card and existing chapter URLs. Do not expand message delivery, ACK, outages, retries, idempotency or Outbox into this lesson.
discussionQuestion: 摘要退出订阅后，同一订单再变为已发货，谁会收到通知？来源与各观察者分别负责什么，共同约定又连接了什么？
